# FG-INT-0025

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`oidc-login`](../../ops/runbooks/oidc-login.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_unreachable_registry_keeps_the_previous_copy` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 組織の台帳を読み込めませんでした。自動で再試行します。
- en: The organisation master could not be read. It will be retried automatically.
- id: Data induk organisasi tidak dapat dibaca. Akan dicoba ulang secara otomatis.

## 原因 (cause)

One run of the worker task `org_master_sync` (ADR-0038 §1, `org.master_sync_enabled`) got no answer from the PFS registry-api (`GET {portal.registry_url}/api/v1/org/units` or `/org/positions`): the connection failed or timed out (`reason=connect`, `connect_timeout`, `timeout`, `tls`, `redirect`, `request`, `body_too_large`), the registry answered a server error (`reason=status`, with `status` 5xx or another status that is neither 200 nor a refusal), or the client-credentials token of the gitstation client could not be obtained (`reason=service_token`, after FG-INT-0024). The previous copy in forge.org_units_master / forge.org_positions_master stays unchanged; the next run waits 1 min, doubling up to `org.master_sync_interval_secs`.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event `forge.org.master_sync_failed` (target forge_cli) with `reason`, `list` (units or positions), `status` and `failures`, never the token or a name. The `forge doctor` row `org.master` shows the age of the copy. A recovery is logged as `forge.org.master_sync_recovered`.

## 対処 (fix)

Usually nothing: a registry that is briefly down catches up. If it persists, follow runbook oidc-login, section 「組織の台帳の写し」 (portal.registry_url, the CA in portal.ca_file, the gitstation client's service account).
